concept: A single failed external call blocks an entire batch of payments, so each payout should be isolated and pulled by the recipient.
scene: Technical diagram on a deep navy background: a row of recipient nodes connected by a line from a central contract node, with one node marked in amber to show the failed call blocking the rest. A separate simple pull-style path is sketched beside it with clean lines and generous spacing.
overlay_text: one failing recipient can block the whole operation
alt_text: Diagram of a contract sending payments to a row of recipients, with one highlighted failing recipient blocking the others, beside a simpler withdraw-style path.
